subject: mathematics
concept: Identifying and naming basic 2D shapes (circle, square, triangle, rectangle)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student traces and sorts virtual shape tiles into named groups
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the named shape among a set of pictured shapes
exercise.abstract: Student names a shape from a simple written or spoken description

misconception_flags: confuses square and rectangle, or circle and oval

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
